maintenance_request.title: Maintenance Request
maintenance_request.description: A booking or technical service request submitted or managed in the Kraken maintenance hub.

id.description: Unique identifier of the maintenance request.

client.description: The name of the client organization or individual requesting maintenance.

service.description: The type of service requested (e.g., Deep Cleaning, HVAC Maintenance).

date.description: The targeted or scheduled date for the service.

status.description: The operational state of the service request.

priority.description: The level of urgency of the request.

amount.description: The financial cost associated with the service request.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns or created this request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated.

maintenance_requests/{requestId}.description: A collection containing all maintenance and service request logs requested via the hub.
